home.description: Frontend-focused software developer building fast, intuitive web experiences. Driven by clean code, performance, and the details that make interfaces feel right.

about.title: About Me
about.description: I started in development out of curiosity and found in frontend the balance between logic and user experience. Today, my focus is on understanding and building software beyond the interface.
about.subtitle: What I’ve worked with:
about.ending: Outside of coding, I enjoy video games (especially Minecraft), building hardware like custom keyboards and PCs, and playing chess.

description: Built gamified campaigns like the World Cup Rally and the Christmas Rally for 10,000–15,000 employees, with 10,000+ participations, mini-games, level progression, digital cards, and dashboards.

Build applications with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and TanStack Query, the stack I championed for the team, integrating REST APIs from the backend team (.NET) based on jointly defined JSON contracts.
Work across the full development lifecycle with Scrum in Jira: requirements, estimation, roadmap, implementation from UX/UI designs, QA, client testing, and production deployment.
Drive the team's technical evolution, promoting best practices and the adoption of AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code.

dialogus.team: Grupo Salinas consultancy · Bienestar, Comunicación e Integración
description: Led the modernization of the team's frontend stack, migrating from vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to React with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Axios, and TanStack Query, and using Astro for high-performance landing pages.

Built and maintained 10+ enterprise web applications, both new and legacy, such as a civil protection manager, an event manager, and an innovation ideas platform, turning Excel-based processes into web systems.
Developed microsites for corporate events like Jalmo and Vida y Movimiento, with agendas, registration forms, Google Analytics, and SEO optimization.
Defined JSON contracts with the backend team (.NET) and integrated their REST APIs, collaborating with UX/UI and QA from requirements to deployment.
Completed the intensive Java Full Stack Developer bootcamp and earned the Generation México and AIFYC certification.
Co-developed RaícesMX, an e-commerce platform with a React frontend, Java Spring Boot backend, and MySQL database, deployed on AWS (EC2, S3).
Built REST APIs for business logic and data persistence, and contributed to the product's UX/UI design.
Worked with Scrum in a cross-functional team, from product definition to deployment.
Developed several video games with Unity and C#, from concept to implementation.
Led the development of Taxi Runner, a 3D endless runner inspired by a taxi driving through Mexico City, which won best game of the semester.
Implemented Taxi Runner's core gameplay mechanics, in a game featuring voxel art and a shop for skins and power-ups.
Coordinated the team as Project Manager, ensuring on-time delivery and effective communication among its members.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Personal and academic projects exploring generative AI, computer vision, 3D, and fullstack apps, always focused on user experience.

cybertracker.label: Gesture-controlled 3D workspace
cybertracker.title: Cybertracker
cybertracker.description: Web experience that uses your webcam and computer vision to manipulate 3D objects with real-time hand gestures, no backend required.
cybertracker.highlight: Two-hand tracking with MediaPipe, relative depth, and quaternion-based 3D rotation, all running in the browser.

clutch-or-cringe.label: AI-powered VALORANT roast card generator
clutch-or-cringe.title: Clutch or Cringe
clutch-or-cringe.description: Web app that analyzes real VALORANT player stats and uses generative AI to create personalized roast cards.
clutch-or-cringe.highlight: Vercel serverless functions that combine real stats with an LLM (Groq), validated with Zod and tested with Vitest.

domux.label: Collaborative home management app
domux.title: Domux
domux.description: Fullstack PWA that helps shared households coordinate tasks, groceries, expenses, and budgets in one place.
domux.highlight: Email and Google OAuth auth with Supabase, admin/member roles, invite codes, and protected routes.
